text: PT Astra Honda Motor (AHM) is a 50% : 50% joint venture of the Jakarta-listed conglomerate PT Astra International Tbk and Honda Motor Co., Ltd., as stated in its entry on the Honda HRC Castrol team's sponsors page.
short: Astra Honda Motor is a 50/50 joint venture of Astra International and Honda Motor.

source.name: Honda HRC Castrol - official team site, Sponsors page (motogp.honda.racing) - Astra Honda Motor entry
source.quote: As a joint venture company of PT Astra International Tbk and Honda Motor Co., Ltd. with the share composition of 50% : 50%
